Supported syntax and limits

The converter checks recognised statements and matching block boundaries. It does not execute expressions, validate types or prove that an algorithm is correct. Keywords are case-insensitive. Use one statement per line.

Structure Notation
Program BEGIN ... END
Input and output INPUT name / OUTPUT "Hello", name
Assignment and declaration SET total = total + value / DECLARE total AS REAL
Selection IF condition THEN ... ELSE ... ENDIF. Use ELSEIF condition THEN for additional branches, or nest IF inside ELSE.
Counted loop FOR i = 1 TO 5 STEP 1 ... ENDFOR. STEP must be a nonzero integer; it defaults to 1.
Conditional loops WHILE condition DO ... ENDWHILE / REPEAT ... UNTIL condition
CASE CASE expression OF, WHEN value:, OTHERWISE:, ENDCASE. Displayed as equivalent chained decisions.
Methods METHOD name(parameters) ... ENDMETHOD , MODULE name(parameters) ... ENDMODULE or FUNCTION name(parameters) RETURNS REAL ... ENDFUNCTION. Define methods outside BEGIN/END.
Calls and returns CALL name(arguments). Hierarchy view also recognises defined function names inside expressions. RETURN creates a terminal exit in a flowchart. Select a method in the section selector to inspect its body.
Comments Use // for whole-line or inline comments outside quoted strings. Maximum 1,000 non-empty lines, 100,000 characters and 16 levels of nesting protect browser responsiveness.

Also accepted: PRINT/DISPLAY, READ, START/STOP, END IF, ELSE IF, plain assignments using = or arrows, FOR ... FROM ... TO, NEXT and WEND. There is no quota or payment per diagram. Structured syntax and browser safety limits still apply.

Hierarchy charts show call relationships, including recursion; uncalled methods are shown separately. Undefined calls are reported. SWITCH / CASE is accepted as an alias for CASE ... OF, WHEN and OTHERWISE. Class syntax, overload resolution, BREAK and CONTINUE are not supported in this release. Use the class diagrams in Unit 5 for object-oriented examples.
